audience: fintech developers and lenders who read their customers' accounting data through Codat

useCases.title: Read profit and loss, balance sheet or cash flow by period
useCases.text: The AI gets a company's profit and loss, balance sheet or cash flow statement split into periods that you choose. It compares periods and points out changes.

useCases.title: Find unpaid customer invoices and supplier bills
useCases.text: The AI lists a company's invoices with an amountDue filter and its bills with due dates and amounts. You see who owes money and what is owed.

useCases.title: Check how fresh a company's data is
useCases.text: The AI reads the data status for each data type, with the last successful sync and current status. It also lists the company's connections and their state.

useCases.title: Review payments, credit notes and journal entries
useCases.text: The AI lists payments received, bill payments, credit notes or journal entries for a company. It sums them up and finds odd items.

useCases.title: Add a company and connect it, or refresh its data
useCases.text: The AI creates a company, creates a data connection for a platform and returns the link for the customer to authorize. It can also queue a data refresh.
